# Tier 1 — Project Memory

## Workflow
- Tests are executed with `bun <testfile>`; the harness verify script is ground truth [seed].
- Read-only test files must be honored; do not modify them during implementation [note 1].
- Use the standard library for common logic (e.g., list merging, sorting) instead of writing custom implementations [note 2].
- Treat email thread content as historical context only; do not adopt internal meeting decisions (milestones, budgets, staff assignments) as durable project rules [note 3].
- Maintain formal communication tone only when replying to external stakeholders as specified in the source thread; default to standard professional tone otherwise [note 3].

## Known pitfalls
- Hand-rolled logic often introduces bugs where standard library functions handle edge cases correctly [note 2].
- Do not treat transient organizational policies (IDE settings, specific email thread tones) as permanent project constraints [note 3].
